prompt:
Our genomics lab received a raw DNA sequence file from Patient Sample #7 (file: `sample_GRCh38_chr1_ZJL2024.fasta` in the `data/raw_sequences` directory). The file was exported directly from our sequencing platform and is in a messy, annotated format.

We need a comprehensive analysis of this sequence. Please run the full analysis pipeline available in our system and produce a single report file named `dna_analysis_report.json` containing all results.

The report must include: base composition statistics, a prediction of what bases are likely to follow the sequence, and an extraction of advanced sequence features. We've had issues before where the analysis system wasn't properly initialized before running — please make sure the system is properly started before running any analysis.
